'''Brad Chester''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[April 2001 Toledo tournament]] on 8 April 2001, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2044">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01d2044/ here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 9 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-09-here-ya-go-chester-toledo-oh-4-8-01d2044/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
